## Before submitting

- [ ] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [x] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)).

## Affected area

FE OSS kernels or CuTeDSL

## Summary
Since this morning, the `python/sdpa/frost:cutlass-rel:sm100` and `:sm103` lanes fail on develop and on every PR, with 374 failures.
- Every failure is the same DSL compile error, in the SM100 FP8 / MXFP8 loader warps:
  ```
  error[TYPE_UNSTABLE_JOIN]: `kv_row_base` has type `None` on one path and `Int32` on another.
  --> cudnn/sdpa/fwd/kernels/sm100/prefill_d256_fp8.py:1085
  ```
- The other two sites are `k_row` at `prefill_d256_mxfp8.py:1352` and `prefill_d512_mxfp8.py:1396`.
- Only the `MAY_BE_EMPTY` builds fail: a mask or split-KV.

## Why

### Root cause
- The refreshed CI test image (DLFW 26.09) ships **quack-kernels 0.6.2**, and every test worker imports it.
- `quack/dsl/mixed_constexpr_if.py` replaces `DSLPreprocessor.visit_If` for the whole process on `import quack`. It rewrites:
  ```python
  if const_expr(S) and D:            if const_expr(S):
      pass                     ->        if D: pass
  else:                                  else: body
      body                           else:
                                         body
  ```
- These loaders have two such regions per tile:
  - The first assigns `kv_row_base` (or the `k_row, ...` tuple from `_kv_tile_coords`).
  - The second contains a `cutlass.range` loop that reassigns the same names.
- Stock DSL: each region is a dynamic `if`, the names are branch-local, and the loop does not carry them.
- Under quack's rewrite: the copy of `body` in the constexpr `else` makes the names function-scoped, so the loop carries them. When `S` (`MAY_BE_EMPTY`) is true, the traced path took the inner dynamic `if`, so the carried value is `None`.

This is not limited to CI. vLLM and SGLang both pin `quack-kernels==0.6.5`, which installs the same patch, and import it. So any such process that compiles one of these FROST rows would fail the same way.


### Fix
- Rename the per-iteration names in those loops (`kv_row_loop`; `k_row_loop, k_page_loop, ...`), so the loops no longer share a name with the prologue.
- Under the stock DSL this changes nothing: the names were loop-local SSA values either way.
- `prefill_d512_mxfp8.py`'s `_SWA_REUSE_P` loop reuses the same tuple and gets the same rename.
- `python/cudnn/AGENTS.md` Rule 7 records the trap and how to detect it.


## Related issues

Related to #1480 (diagnostic, closed), which ruled out #1445.

## API and compatibility impact

None. Kernel-local renames; no API, knob, or capability change.

## Testing
| | result |
|---|---|
| develop pipeline 72364083 (schedule), #1476, #1448 | sm100 374 failed, sm103 374 failed |
| #1480 = develop with #1445 reverted (pipeline 72396599) | sm100 368 / sm103 367 failed: same error, minus #1445's own tests |
| green #1469 (pipeline on base f7182fbe, old image) vs red: pip deltas | apache-tvm-ffi, cuda-pathfinder, nvdisasm; DLFW base 26.08 → 26.09; quack/flash_attn.cute now imported by every worker |
| B200, DSL 4.7.0, develop, `test_prepared_fp8_rebind_scales_and_buffers[output_dtype0-256-256-dtype0-True-True-True]` | passes alone; **fails with the CI error** once `import quack` runs first (also via `import flash_attn.cute`) |
| this PR, `import quack` first, the 374 CI-failed node IDs | **304 passed, 70 skipped, 0 failed** (skips: GB300-only / backend-version cases) |
| this PR, no quack, the 374 IDs + the four SM100 FP8/MXFP8 test files | **1111 passed, 85 skipped, 0 failed** |

sm107, sm120 and sm80 frost lanes on the same image (quack imported) were already green; this pattern only appears in these three SM100 files.

Not measured: SASS identity under the stock DSL. The change is a rename of loop-local values, and the no-quack run is green.

An upstream report to quack about the process-wide `visit_If` patch is drafted separately and has not been filed.

Commands: `pytest -m "L0 or L1 or L2 or L3 or L4" -n 8 <ids>` from `test/python` on B200, nvidia-cutlass-dsl 4.7.0, cuDNN 9.27.0.42. The "quack first" runs add a `-p` plugin that does `import quack` (quack-kernels 0.6.2, the CI image's version).

**Codex bot review · model: `gpt-6-astra`**

Reviewed `3d86e1ebedab` against base `6d9779f5b88a`.

No actionable defect found in this bounded compilation fix. KEEP — finish the bounded change and merge once existing review/CI requirements are met: avoiding a reproducible compile failure when quack is present is useful, and the implementation is limited to renaming loop-local variables in four loops.

Validation: Reviewed all four changed files and their surrounding loader control flow. An independent AST comparison of all three complete kernel files is identical after undoing only the intended variable renames; all renamed uses stay inside the four changed loops, with no stale prologue-coordinate references. The three kernels are also unchanged between the PR merge base and current develop before applying this patch. Ran a reduced control-flow reproducer through the actual CuTeDSL 4.7.0 compiler in separate stock and patched processes, installing the exact quack v0.6.2 mixed-constexpr-if patch. Across 16 old/new, MAY_BE_EMPTY and second-replay-loop combinations: the two old patched MAY_BE_EMPTY cases reproduce TYPE_UNSTABLE_JOIN (None versus Int32); the other 14 compile, including all eight new-form cases. This independently confirms the reported mechanism and the renamed-loop approach. The reduced new-form replay case also compiles with MAY_BE_EMPTY enabled and the same loop-local names in both loops. That does not reproduce the scope concern in the existing SWA replay comment; it is a control-flow check, not full D512 kernel validation. The author reports 304 passed / 70 skipped with quack imported first and 1,111 passed / 85 skipped without it on native SM100. Those full-kernel results are author-provided, not independently rerun here. Existing pipeline 72411006 is running and is reused.

Limitations: This reviewer compiled reduced DSL fragments, not complete attention kernels, and did not execute a GPU test or compare SASS/performance. Source equivalence and the compiler controls do not establish native numerical or capture/replay coverage. The separately reported half-precision capture/replay watchdog timeout remains a separate investigation; this quantized-loader compilation fix does not establish that it is resolved.

Approved: no P0 or high-risk P1 found. Remaining findings stay with the owner; merge timing stays with the owner.

<!-- codex-fe-review:v2:1483:3d86e1ebedab41fa98f881773fc5fa780bfc32f9:complete:no-blocker -->

Not changing this. The hazard needs a name that is first assigned in the `else:` of an `if cutlass.const_expr(S) and D:` (quack copies that body into a constexpr branch, which makes the name function-scoped) and then reassigned by a later dynamic loop. The replay loop sits under a pure `if cutlass.const_expr(_SWA_REUSE_P):` after that `if/else` has closed, and the steady-state loop's `*_loop` names are local to that `cutlass.range` body, so nothing is carried into the replay loop.

Measured on B200 with quack-kernels 0.6.2 imported before the kernel compiles (head 3d86e1e): `test_sdpa_fwd_mxfp8_sm100.py::test_mxfp8_d512_dense_multi_wave_alias` (including `reuse-p`, `diagonal_band_left_bound=128`, i.e. `WINDOW_LEFT == TILE_N - 1`, the `_SWA_REUSE_P` build) and `::test_mxfp8_thd_sliding_window`: 14 passed, 0 `TYPE_UNSTABLE_JOIN`. `@YangXu1990uiuc` Thanks for the clarification. I withdraw this finding.

I applied Rule 7 too broadly. The hazard concerns names first assigned in the `else:` of the mixed constexpr/dynamic conditional, not names local to the steady-state `cutlass.range` body. The replay loop does not carry those coordinates across that conditional. No rename is needed.

Since this morning, the `python/sdpa/frost:cutlass-rel:sm100` and `:sm103` lanes fail on develop and on every PR, with 374 failures.
- Every failure is the same DSL compile error, in the SM100 FP8 / MXFP8 loader warps:
  ```
  error[TYPE_UNSTABLE_JOIN]: `kv_row_base` has type `None` on one path and `Int32` on another.
  --> cudnn/sdpa/fwd/kernels/sm100/prefill_d256_fp8.py:1085
  ```
- The other two sites are `k_row` at `prefill_d256_mxfp8.py:1352` and `prefill_d512_mxfp8.py:1396`.
- Only the `MAY_BE_EMPTY` builds fail: a mask or split-KV.

## Why

### Root cause
- The refreshed CI test image (DLFW 26.09) ships **quack-kernels 0.6.2**, and every test worker imports it.
- `quack/dsl/mixed_constexpr_if.py` replaces `DSLPreprocessor.visit_If` for the whole process on `import quack`. It rewrites:
  ```python
  if const_expr(S) and D:            if const_expr(S):
      pass                     ->        if D: pass
  else:                                  else: body
      body                           else:
                                         body
  ```
- These loaders have two such regions per tile:
  - The first assigns `kv_row_base` (or the `k_row, ...` tuple from `_kv_tile_coords`).
  - The second contains a `cutlass.range` loop that reassigns the same names.
- Stock DSL: each region is a dynamic `if`, the names are branch-local, and the loop does not carry them.
- Under quack's rewrite: the copy of `body` in the constexpr `else` makes the names function-scoped, so the loop carries them. When `S` (`MAY_BE_EMPTY`) is true, the traced path took the inner dynamic `if`, so the carried value is `None`.

This is not limited to CI. vLLM and SGLang both pin `quack-kernels==0.6.5`, which installs the same patch, and import it. So any such process that compiles one of these FROST rows would fail the same way.


### Fix
- Rename the per-iteration names in those loops (`kv_row_loop`; `k_row_loop, k_page_loop, ...`), so the loops no longer share a name with the prologue.
- Under the stock DSL this changes nothing: the names were loop-local SSA values either way.
- `prefill_d512_mxfp8.py`'s `_SWA_REUSE_P` loop reuses the same tuple and gets the same rename.
- `python/cudnn/AGENTS.md` Rule 7 records the trap and how to detect it.


## Related issues

Related to #1480 (diagnostic, closed), which ruled out #1445.

## API and compatibility impact

None. Kernel-local renames; no API, knob, or capability change.

The hazard needs a name that is first assigned in the `else:` of an `if cutlass.const_expr(S) and D:` (quack copies that body into a constexpr branch, which makes the name function-scoped) and then reassigned by a later dynamic loop.
